description: This Java class 'TagService' provides service-layer operations for managing 'Tag' entities in a book tracking application. It includes methods for finding, saving, counting, and deleting tags, utilizing a 'TagRepository' for data access.

classes.name: TagService
classes.description: Service class for managing Tag entities, providing methods for CRUD operations and retrieval based on ID and name.

methods.name: findById
methods.description: Retrieves a Tag by its unique ID, returning an Optional<Tag>.

methods.name: findByName
methods.description: Finds a Tag by its name after trimming whitespace, returning an Optional<Tag>.

methods.name: findAll
methods.description: Returns a list of all Tag entities.

methods.name: save
methods.description: Saves a Tag if a Tag with the same name does not already exist.

methods.name: count
methods.description: Returns the total number of Tag entities.
